verses.text: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the LORD's temple, the gate that faces east. At the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men. Among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
The LORD said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who are planning evil and giving wicked advice in this city.
They say, 'Isn't it almost time to build houses? This city is a cooking pot, and we are the meat, safe inside it.'
So prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man."
Then the Spirit of the LORD came on me, and he told me to say: "This is what the LORD says: That is what you are saying, people of Israel, but I know what is going on in your minds.
You have killed many people in this city and filled its streets with the dead.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: The bodies you have thrown into the city are the meat, and this city is the pot. But I will drive you out of it.
You are afraid of the sword, and the sword is what I will bring against you, says the Lord GOD.
I will drive you out of the city and hand you over to foreigners. I will punish you.
You will fall by the sword. I will judge you at the borders of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
This city will not be a pot to protect you, and you will not be the meat inside it. I will judge you at the borders of Israel.
And you will know that I am the LORD. You have not followed my rules or kept my laws. Instead you have followed the standards of the nations around you."
While I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell face down and cried out in a loud voice, "Oh, Lord GOD! Are you going to completely destroy what is left of Israel?"
Then the LORD's message came to me:

"Son of man, the people of Jerusalem are talking about your brothers, your relatives, your fellow exiles, and all the people of Israel. They are saying, 'They are far away from the LORD. This land has been given to us as our own.'

So say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Even though I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them in other countries, I have been a holy place for them for a little while in the countries where they have gone.'
So say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I will gather you from the nations and bring you back from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel again.'
They will come back to it and remove all its vile images and disgusting idols.
I will give them one heart and put a new spirit in them. I will take away their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh.
Then they will follow my rules and be careful to keep my laws. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
But as for those whose hearts are devoted to their vile images and disgusting idols, I will bring down on their own heads what they have done, says the Lord GOD."
Then the cherubim spread their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
The glory of the LORD rose from the city and stopped above the mountain east of the city.
The Spirit lifted me up and, in the vision given by the Spirit of God, brought me back to the exiles in Babylonia. Then the vision I had seen left me.
And I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me.
